description: This file is an Android Activity class named AccountsTester that provides a user interface for testing and managing Android accounts through the AccountManager API. It includes methods to retrieve, add, remove, and manipulate accounts, as well as handle authentication tokens and account properties.

classes.name: AccountsTester
classes.description: Main activity class for testing account operations in Android. Facilitates account retrieval, addition, removal, and token management through the AccountManager API.

classes.name: AccountArrayAdapter
classes.description: Custom ArrayAdapter for displaying account information with associated icons.

classes.name: GetAccountsCallback
classes.description: Callback for handling results of account retrieval requests.

classes.name: GetAuthTokenCallback
classes.description: Callback for handling results of getAuthToken requests.

classes.name: GetAndInvalidateAuthTokenCallback
classes.description: Callback to get an auth token and then invalidate it.

classes.name: TestHasFeaturesCallback
classes.description: Callback to handle the result of hasFeatures checks.

classes.name: CallbackToDialog
classes.description: Wrapper callback that logs results and displays them in dialogs.

methods.name: initializeAuthenticatorsSpinner
methods.description: Populates the spinner with available authenticator types.

methods.name: onAccountsUpdated
methods.description: Updates the list view when account data changes.

methods.name: getSelectedAuthenticator
methods.description: Returns the authenticator description currently selected in the spinner.

methods.name: showMessageDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog with a message.

methods.name: getAndLogResult
methods.description: Retrieves and logs the result of an AccountManagerFuture operation, showing the outcome in a dialog.
